notes: For the privative min the target head could defensibly be that rather than not; I took not as the word carrying the privative's own negation under rule 48.
again is kept inside the verb's rendering of rise not again; it could alternatively be read as part of the privative frame on מִן, or as added under rule 30, since no morpheme states it separately.

of them that rise up against him: them that is the supplied antecedent for the anarthrous participle (rule 46), and against is the preposition supplied to reach the participle's own suffixed object (rule 44).
